simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יָבָם (H2993) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: יָבָם (yâbâm) means a brother-in-law First listed occurrence: Deut 25 5.

definitions.full: H2993. yabam [ יָבָם ] noun masculine husband's brother (Late Hebrew id. ; יַבְמָא ᵑ7 ; see Lag M ii. 78 ) — only suffix יְבֶמִי Deut 25:7 , יְבָמָהּ 25:5 , in law of levirate marriage (compare Gen 38:8 ; see also Dr Deut 25:5-10 ).
